rows.grounds: distributive reduplicated pronoun indicating each corresponding item
instrumental plural of compound kuṃbha-udaka; internal sandhi u→ā
refers to the recipients mentioned in context
act of bathing or ablution as ritual object

items.question: With what substances must the ritual bathing of those recipients be carried out?
premises: Each respective set of pot waters is specified as the means.
The recipients are indicated as those to whom the action applies.
The ritual bathing is the prescribed action to be performed.
items.inference: Therefore, one should perform the ritual bathing of those recipients using each respective set of pot waters.
uncertainties: The exact identity of teṣāṃ depends on the immediately preceding ritual context.
items.plain_english: And indeed, one should perform the ritual bathing of them with each respective set of pot waters.
